llm_analysis.reasoning: On paper Justin clears every stated requirement, and his transformer depth genuinely exceeds what most new grads bring. But the JD's actual day-to-day work (prompt engineering, agent workflows, A/B tests, guardrails, production serving) is almost entirely absent from a profile built on edge AI, kernel optimization, and robotics. He is a strong ML systems engineer applying to an ML product engineer role. The requirements bar is low enough that he clears it; the responsibilities bar is where the distance shows.
